LanguageData.CC_GodBeast_Walked_Text: On the feast day {PAWN} gave {BEAST} the {KIND} a bite from the hand first, and walked it to {SHRINE} at {HOME}.
LanguageData.CC_GodBeast_Walked_Book: {BEAST} the {KIND} was fed first upon the feast day, and led unto the god's place.
LanguageData.CC_GodBeast_Noted_Bite: was given a bite by hand by {PAWN_nameDef}
LanguageData.CC_GodBeast_Book_Gone: {BEAST} the {KIND} was of {GOD}, and is gone back unto {GOD}.
LanguageData.CC_GodBeast_Book_Slain_legend: The {KIND} that came upon our land was {GOD}'s own, and it was slain by our hands.
LanguageData.CC_GodBeast_Book_Slain_resident: {BEAST} the {KIND} was {GOD}'s, and we have slain it.
LanguageData.CC_GodBeast_Book_Resident: {BEAST} the {KIND}, that will not leave our land, is {GOD}'s, and not ours to hunt.
LanguageData.CC_GodBeast_Book_Stayed: {BEAST} the {KIND}, that is {GOD}'s, abode among us a whole season.
LanguageData.CC_GodBeast_Book_Spared: We let {BEAST} the {KIND} be, for it is {GOD}'s, and not ours to hunt.
LanguageData.CC_GodBeast_ResidentLetter: {PAWN_nameDef} says it is {GOD}'s, and will not hear of it being hunted.
